effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 red Digimon card with the [Vaccine] trait and 1 red Tamer card among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] If you have a red Tamer in play, gain 1 memory.
